title: One Gentle Word
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Morning by morning, soft and new,
He woke Isaiah's ear;
He taught him words both kind and true
For tired hearts to hear.

[Chorus]
One gentle word for weary ones,
One name to whisper low;
When I can't see the path ahead,
He's with me as I go.

[Verse 2]
Isaiah set his face like flint,
And brave and plain he said,
"My Father, He will help me through,"
And walked the road ahead.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
"Who walks where there is not one light?"
Isaiah said it clear;
"Then trust the name of God, and lean
On Him, for He is near."

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
When lights go out and I feel small,
I don't need lamps to see;
I say His name, so soft and sure,
And He's right here with me.

[Chorus]
mood: Walking music in a dark hallway. A steady, even step under the voice, a child's hand finding the wall and then finding a larger hand. One low cello note held under fingerpicked guitar, the guitar answering the end of each line like a quiet reply. Brave rather than soft, and never loud. Each verse a little more sure-footed than the last, and the final chorus steps out into plain daylight.
